name: Takinoue (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Takinoue town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a stylised character with a stalk at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Takinoue, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 February 1958.

features.role: Takinoue town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised character with a stalk at the bottom
